Relationships & care

Start here

A useful starting sequence

A relationship is not a system to optimize. Technology can support logistics and expression, but it should not manufacture your feelings, assume another person's motives, or take away their choices.

Practical guide · 4 min read

Preserve a family story without losing the person's voice

A consent-led way to record, review, and keep a family story, with technology serving the speaker rather than replacing them.

Essay · 3 min read

What should you decide personally, even when a tool helps you express it?

Use help with wording without outsourcing responsibility, inventing feelings, or making promises you do not intend to keep.

Practical guide · 3 min read

Can a reminder help you become a more thoughtful friend?

Use technology to support remembering and showing up without turning friendship into a database or replacing the actual conversation.
